Follower Count

Motion·by @AdityaSur11·2026-09-03·inspora page·original post

What it is

Slider-driven crowd visualization: dragging 0->5,000+ spawns illustrated people sprites that pack into a dense crowd whose silhouette morphs (ellipse blob -> twin-lobe heart) as the count grows.

Media

Frame-by-frame

0-10%
Empty canvas, slider at 0, pill counter reads 0-2; one or two people sprites center.
10-25%
Slider ~40%: dense elliptical crowd blob center-canvas, hundreds of distinct figures packed; pill ~2,000.
25-45%
Slider ~70%: crowd wider than tall; pill ~5,000; silhouette still a rounded mass.
45-75%
Crowd reorganizes into two distinct lobes, left lobe first.
75-95%
Twin-lobe heart/clover silhouette fully formed and packed; pill 5,000+.
95-100%
Slider releases back toward 0; crowd thins to one figure; loop.

Build prompt

Build a scrub-driven crowd counter. Field ~80vw x 60vh (canvas preferred). Target count from a bottom slider (0-5000, log response so small values stay granular). People = 10-20 reused sprite images drawn with drawImage or CSS transforms (never thousands of DOM nodes). Layout: precompute packed positions for N=5000 inside a silhouette SDF; below ~2500 use a single ellipse SDF, above ~2500 lerp the SDF toward a twin-lobe heart mask so the crowd visibly morphs. Count rises: sprites pop in at their slot (scale 0->1, 150ms, random 0-100ms stagger). Count falls: random sprites shrink out. Lerp displayed count toward slider value with a ~250ms spring; black pill shows rounded number with odometer digit roll. Cull offscreen and batch transforms.

Mechanics

trigger
drag on custom slider (scrub)
elements
slider with ticks, black count pill, 10-20 unique person sprite variants instanced thousands of times
properties
instance count, instance positions (packed layout), crowd silhouette mask, pill odometer digits
timing
1:1 scrub; positions lerp ~300ms behind slider
easing
layout ease-out; new sprites pop scale 0->1 150ms
loop
scrub up then auto-release to 0
